dqn_win_rate_pct.description: Percentage of simulated multi-circuit races won outright by the trained DQN strategy policy

dqn_podium_rate_pct.description: Percentage of races finished on the podium (top 3) by the trained DQN strategy policy

dqn_avg_gap_to_winner_s.description: Average gap in seconds to the race winner across all evaluated circuits

dqn_avg_blown_tyre_laps.description: Average number of laps driven beyond the critical tyre cliff (>80% wear)

shap_surrogate_fidelity_r2.description: Coefficient of determination (R2) between TreeSHAP surrogate model predictions and DQN Q-values

tyre_model_fastf1_r2.description: Degradation curve R2 goodness of fit against real historical FastF1 race telemetry data

rag_citation_precision_pct.description: Precision@1 of dense vector semantic retrieval on historical tactical strategy inquiries

rag_refusal_accuracy_pct.description: Accuracy of honest refusal when queried on missing or out-of-distribution race data

temporal_val_2023_r2.description: R2 performance of tyre models on the 2023 chronological validation horizon (FastF1 real telemetry)

temporal_test_2024_r2.description: R2 performance of tyre models on the strictly unseen 2024 prospective holdout test horizon (FastF1 real telemetry)

temporal_leakage_violations.description: Count of detected temporal inversions, session bleeds, or lookahead column leaks (zero tolerance)

prediction_ece_error.description: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) for 95% conformal prediction intervals

prediction_picp_coverage_pct.description: Prediction Interval Coverage Probability (PICP) for nominal 95% confidence intervals

counterfactual_stability_pct.description: Strategy stability score under operational environmental noise perturbations

counterfactual_latency_p95_ms.description: P95 execution latency in milliseconds per 1,000 Monte Carlo forward rollouts

agent_tool_selection_accuracy_pct.description: Accuracy of agent selecting correct domain MCP tool for given race state

agent_citation_grounding_pct.description: Percentage of factual statements directly verified against Context Graph nodes

agent_unsupported_claim_rate_pct.description: Rate of fabricated telemetry values or non-existent model predictions (Zero Hallucination)

agent_context_relevance_pct.description: Relevance of retrieved model cards and feature vectors to current tactical dilemma

agent_missing_context_detection_pct.description: Immediate detection and refusal under missing or corrupted evidence

agent_lineage_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of tactical recommendations backed by complete upstream lineage DAG

agent_evidence_completeness_pct.description: Completeness of required data, weather, and tyre parameters in decision dossier

agent_tool_failure_recovery_pct.description: Rate of clean deterministic fallback when external tool calls time out

agent_decision_consistency_pct.description: Consistency of strategic recommendations across identical stochastic rollout seeds

agent_decision_latency_p99_ms.description: P99 response latency for end-to-end evidence retrieval and decision synthesis
